profileLabel: Center-left economics; mildly liberal social values; institution-supporting (low-medium confidence)
summary: Pampanga 2nd District representative with 88 principal-authored bills. Authored a national jobs guarantee program, a higher senior social pension, civil effects for church-decreed annulments, medical cannabis access, strengthening the political party system and an anti-dynasty ban. Co-authored the national minimum wage and 4Ps expansion.
caveat: Scored only on bills filed in the evidence window and not on earlier public office. Annulment bill direction is moderate; party-system bill details unreviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a national jobs guarantee program (-3) and a higher senior social pension (-3); co-authored 4Ps expansion and national minimum wage (-2 to -3), against co-authored travel tax abolition (+1).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04972, HB05427; co-author HB08647, HB00094, HB08081, HB08464 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored civil effects for church-decreed annulments (+1, easing dissolution of marriage) and medical cannabis access (+2). Two issues, moderate and bills only.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01054, HB03864 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored strengthening the political party system (+2) and an anti-dynasty ban (+3). Two issues, bills only.
